name: EPIC 246054477
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 7.5 solar radii and 0.83 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,560 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.83 solar masses and 7.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,689 K at its surface.
